failures.reason: By design: the sloppy fake agent sends its client assertions with the token endpoint as aud (reading S1 token-endpoint). 0.3 settled S1: 4.1 makes the issuer the aud at every endpoint, so both mocks refuse its first token request with invalid_client and record client-assertion.aud. Its signed-in cells fail; its signed-out ones, which need no token request at 0.3, pass.
